sub_tasks.requirements: The 5p, 10p and 40p cases need independent >=1.5x-grid and >=1.5x-time native reference/device comparisons, max channel changes<=.02, complete traces and valid stopping evidence. Change grid and time separately; a same-record truncation is not an independent time solve. Each of the four required spectra needs half-step new native observations (spacing<=.0025um), followed by adaptive refinement if unresolved; retain initial failed sampling comparisons and require the final successive new-point comparison throughout the full band to have maximum channel-power change<=.02. Early coarse comparisons do not pass merely because later refinement succeeds; only the resolved final spectrum establishes convergence. Use comparison_kind=matched for grid/time and comparison_kind=spectral for sampling, preserving axes. Report center-edge, minimum and outside-integral changes. Shared-point agreement cannot pass sampling convergence. Further control refinement is required if its discretization remains unresolved. Require separate 20p sampling evidence and either independent spatial/time refinement or an explicit conservative discretization justification. Copying another thickness setting is not justification. Resolve thick-slab narrow peaks and retain any failed comparisons.
